prompt: Review whether Vertiv has a current material positive relationship to AI infrastructure and power bottlenecks after the already-queued security review, focusing on data-center power, cooling, backlog conversion, margins and cash.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Higher rack density and data-center deployment increase demand for Vertiv power management, thermal management, integrated modular infrastructure, racks, monitoring and services, with shareholder transmission dependent on order conversion, margins, working capital and capacity execution.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or weaken the edge if organic growth and backlog conversion weaken together, margins reverse, working capital or cash conversion deteriorates, data-center architecture reduces Vertiv content, or capacity and product execution fail.
